_about: Energy Research Warehouse (ERW) site metadata that does not live in Supabase. redivis: read from the Redivis API on 2026-09-26 (dataset properties url, publicAccessLevel, version.isReleased).

redivis.status: The dataset holds every ERW table as an unreleased draft. A version is released by a human after review; until then the dataset is not open to the public.

package.note: pandas is the only dependency. Extras: package[supabase] reads this site's live set, package[redivis] the store of record.
